finalAssets.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the provided project photograph into a highly realistic NIGHT photograph of exactly the same existing garden. Input image 1 is the edit target and is authoritative for every building, tree, plant bed, ground surface, dimension, camera position and framing. Preserve the garden and architectural identity exactly: ochre stucco texture, dark carved Moroccan arches, green tile roofs, window divisions and curtains, imperfect lawn and existing planting. Change only time of day and introduce a restrained, physically plausible proposed exterior lighting installation. Use small discreet matte dark-bronze spike spotlights concealed at planting-bed edges with believable electrical installation hidden underground. Photographic realism with coherent falloff, genuine shadowed areas, fine natural surface detail and camera noise, no CGI, no glossy render, no HDR halos, no fake volumetric beams, no fog, no flares, no glitter, no stars or giant moon, no surreal purple sky, no oversaturated orange wall, no glowing grass. Night lights warm 2700–3000K, balanced against cooler dim sky. No people, no furniture, no extra architecture, no new paths, no rearranged trees, no text, watermarks or logos. Landscape 3:2 at least1536x1024, retain source angle and field of view. The result is an illustrative lighting proposal, visually like a careful professional on-location photograph.
Specific scene: preserve the entire façade with its three arches, low garden beds, large foreground lawn and the round-canopy trees at right. Photograph during the last part of blue hour, after sunset: sky deep muted slate blue, not daylight. About four modest low spotlights within the existing bed wash selected silver foliage, the conical shrub and the broad leaves near the porch. Gentle warm indirect light grazes just a few vertical portions of the ochre facade; do not floodlight the whole wall uniformly. A little interior warmth diffuses through the existing curtains, preserving their texture. The right-side trees have restrained upward highlights from small fixtures, with real unlit portions. Foreground lawn is visibly darker with natural texture and unevenness retained. An inviting believable garden night, not an illuminated hotel advertisement.
